fields.statement: At b39b297 I ran go test ./internal/api -run 'TestParseTrailerLog|TestGitCommits|TestLeafCommit' -count=1 -v and all passed. TestParseTrailerLog (unit test of parseTrailerLog, the reader used by check's gitCommits and by the runner's LeafCommit/ReviewCommit) finds Change: CS4, Actor: a, Leaf: split and Review: R1 when Co-Authored-By sits in a separate final paragraph (case ddd), and still reads Change:/Leaf: when all trailers share the final paragraph (case eee). The subject line is not read as a trailer (fff). TestLeafCommit/'Co-Authored-By in a later paragraph' finds the Leaf: trailer on a real git commit built with split paragraphs. In a scratch worktree I restored the old %(trailers) check.go from edb268a and the same tests failed (TestParseTrailerLog, TestLeafCommit), so the tests pin the fix. I read the diff: trailerLogFormat now emits %B and parseTrailerLog scans every body line after the subject. make check passed fmt-check, vet and test; self-check failed only on stale .rhiza/rendered actor/index files from this run's own model writes, not on this leaf's code.
